hints.title: Trie Style Decimal Traversal Order
hints.text: Lexicographical order corresponds to preorder traversal of a 10-ary tree where children of node x are x * 10 through x * 10 + 9.

hints.title: Iterative Stepping Rules
hints.text: From current value, multiply by 10 if within n. Otherwise increment by 1, dividing by 10 to strip trailing nines or values exceeding n.

hints.title: Simulating Preorder Traversal Iteratively
hints.text: Start with curr = 1. Repeat n times: append curr. If curr * 10 <= n, set curr *= 10. Else, while curr % 10 == 9 or curr >= n, set curr //= 10, then set curr += 1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating strings and sorting them takes O(N * L log N) time with significant allocation overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating decimal digit preorder traversal generates numbers in exact lexicographical sequence.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement the iteration in O(1) auxiliary space without recursion stacks.
